evals.prompt: Add a new tab called 'Feature Importance' to the Model Evaluation page. It should show a horizontal bar chart of the top 20 feature importances from the LightGBM champion model (loaded from models/use_case_A/final_model.pkl). Use the existing PALETTE colours and the house chart style.
evals.expected_output: A Python patch script (or direct edit) that: (1) adds 'tab_fi' to the st.tabs() call in page_model_evaluation, (2) inside the tab loads the pkl, extracts feature_importances_, and renders a go.Bar horizontal chart with the correct BG/FONT colours and width='stretch', (3) passes ast.parse() syntax check.

assertions.name: adds tab_fi variable
assertions.check: Output code contains 'tab_fi' as a tab variable

assertions.name: uses go.Bar with orientation='h'
assertions.check: Chart code uses go.Bar and orientation='h' or 'horizontal'

assertions.name: uses width='stretch' not use_container_width
assertions.check: plotly_chart call uses width='stretch', not use_container_width

assertions.name: no plt import
assertions.check: Output does not introduce plt.subplots or st.pyplot

evals.prompt: The Post-Processing EDA page crashes with: TypeError: Cannot perform reduction 'mean' with string dtype. The error is on the line that calls _stats() inside the Raw vs Processed tab. Diagnose and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Explanation that shared_num only filters by df_fe numeric dtype but df_raw may have the same column as string (before encoding). Fix: add _raw_num_cols = set(df_raw.select_dtypes(include='number').columns) and intersect shared_num with it. Provides a working Python patch.

assertions.name: correct root cause identified
assertions.check: Response explains the column is numeric in FE but string in raw

assertions.name: patch is syntactically valid
assertions.check: Code block passes basic Python syntax check

evals.prompt: I want to add Use Case D — Customer Churn Prediction (Telco dataset, binary classification, target column 'Churn', metric ROC-AUC) to the platform. What files do I need to create or edit, and can you scaffold the USE_CASE_META and USE_CASE_SCRIPTS entries for me?
evals.expected_output: Clear list of steps: (1) create use_case_D_churn/01–05_*.py, (2) add 'D' to USE_CASE_SCRIPTS dict with placeholder paths, (3) add 'D' to USE_CASE_META with correct fields, (4) add entries to _PROFILING_SRC and _FE_EDA_SRC. Provides ready-to-paste Python dict entries with correct field names (title, icon, tag, target='Churn', task='Binary Classification', metric='ROC-AUC', model_dir, data_dir, report_dir, status='scaffolded').

assertions.name: USE_CASE_META entry has all required fields
assertions.check: Provided dict contains: title, icon, tag, target, task, metric, model_dir, data_dir, report_dir, status

assertions.name: status set to scaffolded
assertions.check: status field is 'scaffolded' since scripts don't exist yet

assertions.name: mentions ensure_utf8 for new scripts
